name: Konno Teppei
source:
The main character of this game and the eldest son of five siblings.
Works as a carrier. A little stupid, too lazy to take a bath and unfashionable. 
As a former delinquent, he is a little bit impatient and quickly gets into arguments.
He is a very ordinary person, who is far from being a hero, although also not a bad guy.
